messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — heads up: several orgs (AcmeCorp, BetaLabs) reporting token cost dashboard showing $0 or NaN for last 48h. Customer says billing looks fine on their side. Screenshot attached in thread.
Oliver - Support Lead: Thanks Maria. Can you drop org IDs and any repro steps? Also which dashboard view: per-route or total token cost?
Maria Chen: orgs: org_8442 (AcmeCorp), org_9921 (BetaLabs). They saw this on the top-level Token Cost (monthly) and on the per-model breakdown. Happens in Chrome and mobile.
support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2417 (link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-2417)
Jamal Ortiz: I pulled logs for the metrics pipeline. Transform job succeeded but the final join against pricing table returned price = 0 for those orgs, leading to cost = tokens * 0 -> $0. Also saw a few rows with price = NULL which our downstream math turned into NaN. Suspect race where pricing updates hadn't been applied before aggregation.
Paul (Analytics): Repro query I ran:
```
SELECT u.org_id, u.tokens, p.price_per_token, u.tokens * p.price_per_token AS cost
FROM usage_aggregates u
LEFT JOIN pricing_current p ON u.model = p.model
WHERE u.org_id IN ('org_8442','org_9921') AND date >= '2026-03-10';
```
Result: price_per_token = 0 or NULL for affected rows.
Erin (SRE): On infra side we had a leader election in the pricing-service Kafka topic around 03:14 UTC yesterday; partition 6 was briefly stuck and the update stream missed ~7k messages. That would explain stale pricing for some customers.
Oliver - Support Lead: Good find. Is this recoverable via backfill or do we need immediate patch to guard dashboards?
Jamal Ortiz: Two options:
1) Backfill pricing by replaying the pricing topic for the window; will recompute costs and fix dashboard historically. ETA ~2h if we run table-resync job.
2) Short-term guard: change dashboard computation to treat NULL/0 price as "unknown" instead of 0 and show "—"/warning. Patch = small frontend + query guard. ETA ~1h for hotfix.
Paul (Analytics): Also recommend metric-level alert when pricing_join_count < usage_rows to catch mismatches early.
Maria Chen: Customer asked for immediate remediation. They want numbers fixed in the UI.
Erin (SRE): I'll kick the replay job for pricing-topic partition 6 now. Command:
```
./infra/tools/kafka-replay --topic pricing-updates --partition 6 --from-offset 1384920 --to-offset 1389920 --tenant org_8442,org_9921
```
Starting job id: replay-20260316-11. Monitor: logs at /var/log/replay/replay-20260316-11.log
Jamal Ortiz: After replay finishes I'll trigger downstream aggregator recompute: `python scripts/recompute_usage_costs.py --start 2026-03-09 --end 2026-03-16 --orgs org_8442,org_9921`.
Oliver - Support Lead: Assigning owners: Erin = infra/replay, Jamal = recompute + verification, Paul = dashboard display patch, Maria = customer comms. ETA sync in 45m.
Paul (Analytics): For the dashboard patch, I'll add COALESCE(p.price_per_token, -1) and frontend maps -1 => "pricing unavailable". Also will ensure divide-by-zero protection.
Jamal Ortiz: Quick verification steps for support: 1) Wait for replay job to finish. 2) Run the SELECT above to confirm price_per_token populated. 3) If ok, clear cache for dashboard route via admin panel (Console -> Caches -> token-cost -> purge). 4) Tell customer to refresh.
Maria Chen: Noted. I'll tell them we're replaying events and expect corrected numbers within ~3 hours. Will update ticket.
Erin (SRE): Replay finished: exit 0, no errors. Log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T11:37:22Z] replay: partition 6 replayed 524k msgs
[2026-03-16T11:37:22Z] replay: ended successfully, committed offsets
```
Jamal Ortiz: Recompute done. Sample query now returns:
```
org_8442 | 120431 | 0.0002 | 24.0862
org_9921 | 98320  | 0.00015| 14.7480
```
Paul (Analytics): Dashboard patch deployed to prod canary (10%) — shows "pricing unavailable" for rows where price missing and no more $0/NaN for those orgs. Will roll to 100% in 30m if metrics stable.
Oliver - Support Lead: Maria, can you confirm customer sees updated values after we roll? Also add a note in ticket about root cause (kafka partition leader election caused missed pricing updates) and mitigation steps.
Maria Chen: Customer confirmed numbers updated and they can see non-zero costs. They appreciated the quick response. Closing loop and will mark INC-2026-2417 as resolved once patch fully rolled.
Oliver - Support Lead: Follow-ups: (1) Add retry/guard in transform to prevent NULL->NaN (Jamal). (2) Add monitoring alert when pricing updates lag (Erin/Paul). (3) Postmortem to be scheduled tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:
